pr_title: Bluetooth: host: cancel limited adv timeout when advertising stopped
pr_body:
Advertising might stop when:
- it was stopped by application
- device connected to a peer
- extended advertising reached stop condition
  defined in BT_LE_EXT_ADV_START_PARAM - this is handled in ll

Signed-off-by: Krzysztof Kopyściński <krzysztof.kopyscinski@codecoup.pl>

Fixes #37467
pr_comments: @KKopyscinski can you please address the review comments?
@sjanc What's the reason for closing this pull request?

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: host: Incorrect advertiser timeout handling when using Limited Discoverable flag
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Issues in advertising timeout when application has set BT_LE_AD_LIMITED flag in advertising data.

- bt_le_ext_adv_stop() and bt_le_adv_stop() should also cancel delayed work ie. if called by application before timeout is reached
- delayed work should be cancelled when set terminated ie due to connection or parameters set via BT_LE_EXT_ADV_START_PARAM
- if advertising is terminated, how application will know about this? should "sent" callback be called? what about legacy advertising (with ext_adv disabled in kconfig)?

**Impact**
Using the BT_LE_AD_LIMITED flag leaves the advertising set timeout running, this could potentially stop an advertiser it was not supposed to stop, or lead to an ASSERT  (if CONFIG_ASSERT is enabled).

Discussion: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/37426#discussion_r682509680
comments:
This issue should have been linked to the new PR.

This comment needs to be addressed in order to close this issue: https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/37929#pullrequestreview-741589436

review_comments:
This check is incorrect. You should call bt_le_adv_stop() if `adv == bt_dev.adv` (Meaning it is the legacy advertiser and was started with bt_le_adv_start()), otherwise use bt_le_ext_adv_stop() (because it was started with bt_le_ext_adv_start()).

Please make this separate commit as it is a different problem than the timeout fix.

The assert seems like a bad idea. You'd have to be 100% sure that you don't have any race on who's stopping the advertiser.
And failing to stop and advertiser (because it is already stopped) isn't something that should warrant an assert in my opinion. I would feel much better if this was a BT_WARN instead.
Could this be added as a bit in `adv->flags` instead?
The busy status is not used, so this should be removed.
